title: The request to start a run of one eval
description: The body of POST {RATEL_BASE_URL}/evals/{eval}/runs, {eval} is the name or the id of the eval (URL-encoded). Each field is optional.

sandboxVersion.description: The id of an image version (protocol/sandbox/v1 version), or latest: the newest ready version. Absent: latest. A version of another sandbox than the sandbox of an eval does not apply to that eval: the eval runs on the newest ready version of its own sandbox, and its part of the answer has a note.

sandbox.description: The sandbox whose newest ready version latest is: the name of its ratel.yaml.

dataset.description: The id or the name of a dataset. The run uses its cases in place of the cases of the eval. Only for this run: the eval does not change.

params.description: The parameter values that each run gets: a flat object of the parameters that ratel.yaml declares.

matrix.description: The parameters with more than one value. Each combination of the values is one variant of the run, with the params. At most 12 combinations.

trials.description: The trials for each case. Absent: the trials of the eval.

label.description: Run only the cases with this label.
